summary: Iran launched missiles from Khomein and Aligudarz while US strikes killed an Iranian air defense member in Jask, prompting Iranian retaliation that triggered sirens in Bahrain, injured three including a child in Qatar from missile debris, and damaged a container ship near Oman. Israeli forces conducted a drone strike on a factory in western Gaza City, eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza, operated in West Bank villages after a shooting report, and struck multiple locations in southern Lebanon and the Bekaa Valley. The Strait of Hormuz remains contested with IRGC claiming closure while US CENTCOM asserts it is open, as Oman's Musandam Governorate came under drone attack and Kuwait conducted EOD operations for explosive remnants in Sabhan.
key_points: Iran launched missiles from Khomein and Aligudarz with explosions heard in Zanjan. (Source: @VahidOnline/76947)
US strikes on Jask killed Iranian Army air defense member Hamidreza Dehghan. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75654)
Iranian retaliation triggered sirens in Bahrain and injured three, including a child, in Qatar from missile interception debris. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4842, @Faytuks_Network/4845)
Drone attack hit Oman's Musandam Governorate bordering Strait of Hormuz; container ship damaged near Oman coast. (Source: @asafroz/51322, @inon_yttach/9371)
Israeli drone struck Beit Afaneh factory in western Gaza City with three missiles, causing casualties. (Source: @kianmeli1/88789)
IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza: Hassan Al-Razina and Muhammad Fayoumi. (Source: @New_security8200/202457)

Israeli strikes hit Mansouri in southern Lebanon and Serein Al-Fawqa in Bekaa Valley; artillery shelled multiple border towns. (Source: @manniefabian/58769, @rasedal3ado138e/376516, @redlinkleb/31045)
US CENTCOM and Iran dispute Strait of Hormuz status; Kuwait Army conducting EOD operations in Sabhan for explosive remnants. (Source: @shin_persian/7705, @shin_persian/7704)

points: Iran launched two missiles each from Khomein and Aligudarz in Lorestan Province, with missile trails observed and loud explosions heard in Zanjan, indicating a significant missile salvo. (Source: @VahidOnline/76947)

US military strikes targeted the Jask region in Hormozgan Province, killing Hamidreza Dehghan, a member of the Iranian Army Air Defense, marking a direct US kinetic action against Iranian military personnel. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75654)

Iranian retaliation included missile fire triggering air raid sirens in Bahrain, while missile interception debris fell in Qatar injuring three people including one child, per Qatar's Interior Ministry. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4842, @Faytuks_Network/4845)

A drone attack struck Oman's Musandam Governorate, which borders the Strait of Hormuz, and a container ship sustained damage near the Omani coast, per UKMTO reporting. (Source: @asafroz/51322, @inon_yttach/9371)

IRGC declared the Strait of Hormuz closed, but US CENTCOM stated the strait remains open to all vessels with US forces positioned to ensure freedom of navigation despite Iranian aggression. (Source: @inon_yttach/9379, @shin_persian/7705)
UKMTO issued Warning 083-26 Update 002 highlighting an extremely severe security threat in the Strait of Hormuz, reflecting heightened maritime risk. (Source: @shin_persian/7690)
Yemen's Foreign Ministry expressed support for Iran against US and Israeli aggression, stating continued attacks will not achieve their criminal goals. (Source: @SharghDaily/171439)

IDF forces deployed to Al-Mughayyir and Khirbet Abu Falah in the Benjamin Brigade area after an Israeli citizen reported gunfire, conducting searches and establishing roadblocks with no injuries reported. (Source: @idf_telegram/24599)
135 Israeli settlers entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound during morning hours under Israeli police protection, according to Palestinian sources. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376509)

A technical glitch caused a preliminary emergency alert to be sent to mobile phones in central Israel; IDF confirmed no security incident and is underway. (Source: @inon_yttach/9377, @amitsegal/62967)
The Israeli government extended the special home front situation until July 28 due to ongoing security developments, granting emergency authorities. (Source: @yediotnews25/132546)
IDF revealed a Hezbollah terror infrastructure at the historical Beaufort outpost, including tunnels, anti-aircraft missiles, and an underground clinic for militants. (Source: @idf_telegram/24604)

Israeli warplanes were reported flying towards Lebanon at maximum alert, with multiple artillery shelling incidents in southern Lebanese towns. (Source: @redlinkleb/31043, @redlinkleb/31045, @redlinkleb/30950, @redlinkleb/30998)
An Israeli drone fired three missiles at the Beit Afaneh factory on Al-Shana'a Street in western Gaza City, causing an unspecified number of casualties per local reports. (Source: @kianmeli1/88789)

IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza: Hassan Mustafa Zahir Al-Razina, who was planting explosives near the border fence, and Muhammad Mahmoud Abdul-Muti Fayoumi, a Nukhba operative planning imminent attacks. (Source: @New_security8200/202457)

IDF conducted a nighttime operation in the West Bank villages of Al-Mughayyir and Khirbet Abu Falah following a shooting report, searching for suspects and blocking roads. (Source: @idf_telegram/24599)
135 settlers stormed the Al-Aqsa Mosque during morning visiting hours under Israeli police protection, escalating tensions in Jerusalem. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376509)
Lebanese media reported several Israeli strikes on the southern town of Mansouri, indicating continued Israeli air operations in the border area. (Source: @manniefabian/58769)
Israeli warplanes struck the town of Serein Al-Fawqa in the central Bekaa Valley, expanding the geographic scope of strikes beyond the immediate border. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376516)

Artillery shelling hit multiple southern Lebanese locations including Zoutar Al-Sharqiyah, Deir Sarian, Al-Qantara, and Kfar Tibnit, per Lebanese security sources. (Source: @redlinkleb/31045, @redlinkleb/30950, @redlinkleb/30998)
The Lebanese Army announced a controlled detonation in the town of Aita Al-Jabal, likely related to unexploded ordnance from previous strikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/31018)
Israeli warplanes were observed flying towards Lebanon at maximum alert, suggesting heightened air activity and potential for further strikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/31043)

Iraqi government spokesperson Haider Al-Aboudi stated the government will address the cabinet vacancy by sending a delegation to the United States to halt Iranian intervention. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82515)

Yemen's Foreign Ministry issued a statement supporting Iran against US and Israeli aggression, affirming that continued attacks will not achieve their criminal objectives. (Source: @SharghDaily/171439)
Air raid sirens sounded in Bahrain again as Iranian retaliation continues following US strikes on Iran, per regional monitoring. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4842)
Three people, including one child, were injured in Qatar by debris from Iranian missile interceptions, according to Qatar's Interior Ministry. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4845)
Oman's Musandam Governorate, bordering the Strait of Hormuz, was attacked by drones this morning, per Omani reports. (Source: @asafroz/51322)
A container ship was damaged near the Omani coast in the Strait of Hormuz, per UKMTO, amid heightened maritime threat warnings. (Source: @inon_yttach/9371)

Kuwait Army Land Force EOD teams are handling shrapnel and explosive remnants in the Sabhan area on July 12 from 15:00 to 16:00 local time, with explosion sounds expected. (Source: @shin_persian/7704, @naya_foriraq/82522)
US CENTCOM declared the Strait of Hormuz open to all vessels with US forces positioned to ensure freedom of navigation despite Iranian aggression. (Source: @shin_persian/7705)
